Build Motion Shelf into a centralized animation library where users can easily browse, preview, select, and use animations. The final integration should allow an animation to be applied with a simple class name, while Motion Shelf handles animation discovery, normalization, metadata, synchronization, and reusable code behind the scenes.

Users can easily find, preview, and apply animations using a simple class name without manually copying keyframes or implementation code. Animations are consistently structured, customizable, deduplicated, synchronized, and documented. The animation library is prepared for design-team review, allowing designers to evaluate, approve, reject, or request adjustments to animations before they are considered final.

tasks.title: Refine the editor and showcase interfaces for imported animations
tasks.description: Redesign and adapt the animation editor and showcase (View Details) modals to support upcoming animations imported from the campaigns and previews-only folders. Establish a consistent, responsive interface that accommodates varying animation structures, image dimensions, aspect ratios, and interaction patterns. Ensure previews accurately represent imported content and that editing controls apply only to the selected animation. Preserve existing functionality and verify both modal workflows against representative imported animations across desktop and mobile layouts.

tasks.title: Redesign the animation editor modal
tasks.description: Redesign the animation edit modal as a new, complete interface. Keep the image preview sticky once it reaches the top of the modal while scrolling. Introduce an adjustable class-based approach for the current animation only, so edits are scoped to that animation and never change other animations at the same time. Include all controls and interaction states needed for the new editing experience, while keeping the modal responsive and preserving existing working behavior.

tasks.title: Auto-classify imported campaign animations
tasks.description: When animations are imported from the Campaigns/Preview-only folder, automatically inspect and classify their default properties. Detect hover behavior, image usage, div/container structure, and every relevant animation property available by default. Use that analysis to sort and adjust the imported animation metadata automatically, while keeping the import resilient to different animation structures. Detect duplicate and near-duplicate animations, including variants with different names, timings, or small display changes, and show only one canonical animation in the library.

tasks.title: Create a CDN-hosted, tree-shakable animation library with dynamic imports
tasks.description: Design and implement a publishable animation library that can be served from a CDN and consumed without loading the entire collection. Export each animation as an independently importable module with clear, stable names and a lightweight public entry point. Ensure bundlers can tree-shake unused animations, and provide dynamic-import helpers so an application loads an animation only when it is selected or needed. Define a consistent module structure, metadata contract, and versioning strategy; keep shared runtime code minimal; handle loading failures gracefully; and document example static and dynamic import usage. The library must preserve the existing animation behavior while making individual animations fast to discover, load, and cache.

tasks.title: Create reusable animation templates with CSS variables
tasks.description: Replace collections of nearly identical animation files with reusable templates built on shared keyframe structures. Move adjustable values—such as duration, delay, distance, scale, rotation, easing, opacity, and transform origin—into documented CSS custom properties. Allow projects and individual elements to override those variables without copying or modifying the shared animation definition. Keep keyframes centralized, preserve current visual behavior where possible, define sensible defaults and fallbacks, and document how to apply and customize each template.

tasks.title: Scan and integrate campaign animation styles
tasks.description: Scan the campaigns and previews-only folders, collect all animation classes, keyframes, and related styles, then organize and integrate them into the Motion Shelf animation library.
